Use case: stylized-concept. Production fullbody character cutout for the Chinese Three Kingdoms RPG 异界三国. Art direction: grounded, cinematic realistic CG in the direction of Dynasty Warriors: Origins, believable historical Chinese late-Han people, not uniformly beautiful fashion models. Strong distinct character silhouette and face. Detailed physically believable skin, iron, bronze, linen and leather, clear neutral soft cinematic lighting. One person standing in relaxed three-quarter view. Vertical 1024x1536 canvas, complete head and boots and weapon in frame with safe margin, head centered near (512,170), figure about90% image height. Genuinely transparent alpha background, clean outline, no colored haze, backdrop, floor or ground shadow. No text, logos, UI or watermarks.

Thin gaunt angular Chinese face, deep-set piercing eyes, lined cheeks, sparse dark goatee, untidy long black hair with grey strands partly under a simple dark Taoist hood. Lean slightly hunched posture, layered weathered charcoal, muted olive and ochre ritual robes, ragged sleeve edges, cord belt, subtle bronze occult ornaments and yellow cloth ties. Holds a few ochre paper talismans between gnarled fingers, other hand in a restrained ritual gesture.
